class.name: NetwPredictEpisodeReport
class.brief_description: A by-value snapshot of one prediction episode: its generator, writes, comparisons, and decisions, addressed by series and index.
class.description: A copy of one recovery episode's evidence, taken at a moment in time so it keeps answering after the episode that produced it closes, reopens under a new [method id], or is overwritten in its slot. [method active] is the only member that can read differently between two reports of the same episode; every other member reads whatever was true when the snapshot was made. [br][br]Evidence that repeats per row, writes, comparisons, decisions, secondary generators, taint, and the reopen chain, is addressed by series and index rather than boxed into a [Dictionary], so a caller walks a count against per-index accessors instead of unpacking a fixed key set. [codeblock] for i in report.write_count(): var op = report.write_operator(i) var outcome = report.write_outcome(i) [/codeblock] [method to_dictionary] rebuilds a fixed-key payload from the same series, for a signal or a tool that wants one value to pass along rather than a typed walk. [br][br]The generator is the journal row whose divergence opened the episode. [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code] only when that row had already aged out of the journal ring before it could be pinned, the one case where the [code]generator_*[/code] fingerprint accessors answer zero rather than the pinned value. [method secondary_generator_count] counts further divergences the episode attributes independently of the generator, evidence that widens the episode without becoming what it is about.

method.name: active
method.description: Whether an episode is open or in fallback. A report survives its own close, so the id alone cannot tell a live episode from the last one.

method.name: agreement_run
method.description: How many trailing comparisons in a row agreed under the current [method agreement_write_id]. A disagreement resets it to [code]0[/code], and a comparison that starts judging a different write restarts it at [code]1[/code] rather than extending the previous write's count. The episode closes once this reaches the ack-age-derived run length, so the run always belongs to one write's attempt.

method.name: agreement_write_id
method.description: The [method write_id] [method agreement_run] is currently counted against, or [code]0[/code] before any comparison has agreed.

method.name: aligned_transition
method.description: The transition an alignment reseed last matched against, or [code]-1[/code] before one has landed. Set when a fallback episode's alignment operator succeeds, which is also what closes the fallback.

method.name: attribution
method.description: This episode's [enum NetwPredictJournal.Attribution], the cause the generator's divergence was assigned. Set at [code]open[/code] and updated whenever the episode's generator is repinned.

method.name: breach_transition
method.description: The transition whose realized contact demoted this episode's owner out of speculation, or [code]-1[/code] when no contact has. The contact itself stays with the caller that sampled it, since a peer compares only a witness fingerprint and never the contact detail.

method.name: closed_transition
method.description: The transition at which this episode closed, either by agreement or by leaving fallback, or [code]-1[/code] while it is still open.

method.name: closure_used
method.description: How many [constant NetwPredictJournal.FULL_CLOSURE] writes this episode has recorded. The episode is forced into fallback once this reaches its budget, a budget [method non_contraction_used] counts against separately and does not share.

method.name: comparison_agrees
method.description: Whether the comparison at [param index] agreed with the episode's live prediction. A run of these driving [method agreement_run] to its threshold is what closes the episode.

method.name: comparison_count
method.description: How many comparisons this episode has recorded, the bound for [param index] on every [code]comparison_*[/code] accessor.

method.name: comparison_meter
method.description: The divergence meter the comparison at [param index] measured. A write's outcome contracts against the meter trending toward [code]0[/code], not against a single comparison agreeing.

method.name: comparison_transition
method.description: The transition the comparison at [param index] judged, or [code]-1[/code] past [method comparison_count].

method.name: comparison_write_id
method.description: The [method write_id] that was outstanding when the comparison at [param index] was recorded, [code]0[/code] when none was.

method.name: decision_applied
method.description: Whether the decision at [param index] was carried out rather than merely judged eligible. A decision can be [method decision_eligible] and still not applied when a later constraint withdrew it.

method.name: decision_basis
method.description: The transition the decision at [param index] was made against, or [code]-1[/code] when it names none.

method.name: decision_count
method.description: How many operator decisions this episode has recorded, the bound for [param index] on every [code]decision_*[/code] accessor.

method.name: decision_eligibility
method.description: A duplicated [Dictionary] of the eligibility facts that were weighed for the decision at [param index], the detail behind [method decision_eligible] rather than the verdict itself. Its keys are the operator's own eligibility checks and are not part of this class's contract.

method.name: decision_eligible
method.description: Whether the operator named by the decision at [param index] was judged eligible to run, independent of whether it was [method decision_applied].

method.name: decision_operator
method.description: The [enum NetwPredictJournal.Operator] the decision at [param index] weighed.

method.name: demoted
method.description: Whether this episode's owner lost speculative authority when it entered fallback, as opposed to entering fallback while still predicting. Set once, at [method fallback_transition].

method.name: dissipate_decided
method.description: Whether this episode has ever recorded a decision for [constant NetwPredictJournal.DISSIPATE]. Unlike [method write_count], a decision can be recorded without producing a write, so this is the only record that the operator was ever weighed at all.

method.name: evidence_dropped
method.description: How many evidence rows, across writes, comparisons, decisions, taint, and secondary generators, this episode has discarded to stay within its retention bounds. A nonzero count means an older row was silently trimmed before a caller could read it, never that evidence was refused outright.

method.name: evidence_free_non_contractions
method.description: How many non-contractions this episode has recorded for a write whose divergence carried no evidence to trigger on. Counted separately from [method non_contraction_used] because an evidence-free non-contraction never spends the episode's contraction budget.

method.name: fallback_transition
method.description: The transition at which this episode entered fallback, or [code]-1[/code] if it never has. Distinct from [method opened_transition]: an episode can run its writes to exhaustion before falling back.

method.name: generator_attribution
method.description: The generator row's own [enum NetwPredictJournal.Attribution], pinned at the moment the journal recorded it. Can differ from [method attribution] after a repin moves the episode's generator without moving its cause.

method.name: generator_beyond_retention
method.description: Whether the generator row aged out of the journal ring before this episode could pin it. When [code]true[/code], every [code]generator_*[/code] fingerprint accessor answers its zero default rather than a pinned value, and [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_c_hash
method.description: The command hash the journal recorded for the generator transition, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_domain
method.description: The generator row's [enum NetwPredictJournal.Domain], pinned at the moment it was recorded.

method.name: generator_e_digest
method.description: The environment digest the journal recorded for the generator transition, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_evidence_mask
method.description: The bitmask of which evidence kinds the generator row carried, [constant NetwPredictJournal.EVIDENCE_WITNESS] and [constant NetwPredictJournal.EVIDENCE_RAW] combined. Reads [code]0[/code] whenever [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code], which is indistinguishable from an evidence-free row, so pair it with [method generator_present] before trusting a zero.

method.name: generator_flags
method.description: The generator row's flag bits, an [constant NetwPredictJournal.ROW_DIVERGENT]-style combination pinned at the moment it was recorded.

method.name: generator_label
method.description: The command label the generator transition carried, or [code]-1[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_post_controller_fp
method.description: The controller-latch fingerprint the journal recorded after the generator transition closed, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_post_fp
method.description: The combined post-state fingerprint the journal recorded after the generator transition closed, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_post_momentum_fp
method.description: The momentum-family fingerprint the journal recorded after the generator transition closed, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_post_pose_fp
method.description: The pose-family fingerprint the journal recorded after the generator transition closed, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_pre_controller_fp
method.description: The controller-latch fingerprint the journal recorded before the generator transition ran, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_pre_fp
method.description: The combined pre-state fingerprint the journal recorded before the generator transition ran, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_pre_momentum_fp
method.description: The momentum-family fingerprint the journal recorded before the generator transition ran, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_pre_pose_fp
method.description: The pose-family fingerprint the journal recorded before the generator transition ran, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_present
method.description: Whether the generator row was successfully pinned from the journal. [code]false[/code] means the row had already aged out of the ring by the time this episode tried to pin it, and every [code]generator_*[/code] fingerprint accessor then answers a zero default rather than real evidence.

method.name: generator_raw_fp
method.description: The unclassified raw fingerprint the journal recorded for the generator transition, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_topology_fp
method.description: The topology fingerprint the journal recorded for the generator transition, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: generator_transition
method.description: The transition the journal pinned as this episode's generator, or [code]-1[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code]. Usually equal to [method opened_transition], but a repin can move it forward without opening a new episode.

method.name: generator_witness_fp
method.description: The witness fingerprint the journal recorded for the generator transition, [code]0[/code] when [method generator_present] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: id
method.description: This episode's id, unique within its slot and increasing across every episode the slot has ever opened. [code]0[/code] identifies no episode; a real id is always positive.

method.name: last_comparison_transition
method.description: The transition of the most recent comparison this episode recorded, or [code]-1[/code] before its first one. A comparison naming a transition at or before this one is refused as stale rather than recorded twice.

method.name: last_write_id
method.description: The [method write_id] of the most recent write this episode recorded, or [code]0[/code] before its first one.

method.name: mixed_trigger_non_contractions
method.description: How many of this episode's non-contractions were judged against a mixed trigger shape, some evidence triggering and some withheld, as opposed to [method no_trigger_non_contractions]. Both are counted within [method non_contraction_used] and never within [method withheld_non_contractions] or [method evidence_free_non_contractions].

method.name: no_trigger_non_contractions
method.description: How many of this episode's non-contractions were judged with no evidence triggering at all, as opposed to [method mixed_trigger_non_contractions]. Both are counted within [method non_contraction_used].

method.name: non_contraction_used
method.description: How many writes this episode has failed to contract, excluding the withheld and evidence-free cases counted separately by [method withheld_non_contractions] and [method evidence_free_non_contractions]. The episode is forced into fallback once this reaches its budget.

method.name: opened_transition
method.description: The transition at which this episode was opened, the divergence its generator was pinned against.

method.name: quarantine_clean_run
method.description: The consecutive clean run this episode's quarantine has accumulated toward [method quarantine_target], while the episode sits in fallback.

method.name: quarantine_target
method.description: The consecutive clean run this episode's quarantine must reach before authority is trusted enough to resume prediction. Scaled by the episode's flap history, so a slot that keeps re-entering fallback for conflicting reasons is held to a longer proof each time.

method.name: reopen_at
method.description: The episode id at position [param index] of the reopen chain, oldest first, [code]0[/code] past [method reopen_count].

method.name: reopen_count
method.description: How many ids the reopen chain carries, the bound for [param index] on [method reopen_at]. A chain of length one is an episode that has never reopened.

method.name: reopened_from
method.description: The [method id] of the episode this one reopened from, or [code]0[/code] when this episode opened fresh rather than within the flap window of a prior closure.

method.name: reseed_transition
method.description: The basis transition the most recent accepted quarantine reseed selected, or [code]-1[/code] before one has landed.

method.name: resume_ack_age
method.description: The acknowledgment age, in ticks, that was in effect when this episode entered quarantine. [method quarantine_target] is derived from it, so a resume proof is priced against how stale acknowledgment was at the moment authority was lost.

method.name: secondary_generator_attribution
method.description: The [enum NetwPredictJournal.Attribution] pinned for the secondary generator at [param index].

method.name: secondary_generator_beyond_retention
method.description: Whether the secondary generator at [param index] had already aged out of the journal ring before it could be pinned, mirroring [method generator_beyond_retention] for a row that is not this episode's primary generator.

method.name: secondary_generator_count
method.description: How many independent divergences this episode has recorded beyond its generator, the bound for [param index] on every [code]secondary_generator_*[/code] accessor. Capped at 16 rows; further ones are dropped and counted in [method evidence_dropped].

method.name: secondary_generator_domain
method.description: The [enum NetwPredictJournal.Domain] pinned for the secondary generator at [param index].

method.name: secondary_generator_flags
method.description: The flag bits pinned for the secondary generator at [param index], the same bit layout as [method generator_flags].

method.name: secondary_generator_label
method.description: The command label pinned for the secondary generator at [param index], or [code]-1[/code] past [method secondary_generator_count].

method.name: secondary_generator_transition
method.description: The transition pinned as the secondary generator at [param index], or [code]-1[/code] past [method secondary_generator_count].

method.name: state
method.description: This episode's [enum State]: [constant EPISODE_OPEN] while comparisons are still being judged, [constant EPISODE_FALLBACK] while it waits on a quarantine proof, or [constant EPISODE_CLOSED] once it has closed by either path.

method.name: taint_at
method.description: The transition recorded as taint at [param index], a divergence this episode observed but could not attribute independently of its generator, [code]-1[/code] past [method taint_count].

method.name: taint_count
method.description: How many taint transitions this episode has recorded, the bound for [param index] on [method taint_at].

method.name: transport_decided
method.description: Whether this episode has ever recorded a decision for [constant NetwPredictJournal.TRANSPORT_DELTA], independent of whether that decision was [method decision_applied].

method.name: withheld_non_contractions
method.description: How many non-contractions this episode has recorded for a write whose triggering evidence was entirely withheld. Counted separately from [method non_contraction_used] because a withheld non-contraction never spends the episode's contraction budget.

method.name: write_basis
method.description: The transition the write at [param index] was computed against, or [code]-1[/code] when it names none.

method.name: write_best_meter
method.description: The lowest divergence meter any comparison has measured against the write at [param index] so far. Tracked separately from [method write_meter_before] because a [constant NetwPredictJournal.DISSIPATE] write judges improvement against its own best rather than against its starting meter.

method.name: write_count
method.description: How many writes this episode has recorded, the bound for [param index] on every [code]write_*[/code] accessor.

method.name: write_delta_fp
method.description: The fingerprint of the correction the write at [param index] applied, stamped after the fact by [code]stamp_write_delta[/code] once the correction's shape is known.

method.name: write_episode
method.description: The [method id] of the episode that recorded the write at [param index]. Always equal to this report's own [method id], since a report never carries another episode's writes.

method.name: write_evidence_free
method.description: Whether the write at [param index] was recorded against a divergence that carried no triggering evidence at all. Governs whether a non-contraction on this write counts toward [method evidence_free_non_contractions] instead of [method non_contraction_used].

method.name: write_id
method.description: The write id of the write at [param index], unique within this episode and increasing with every write it records.

method.name: write_judged_transition
method.description: The transition whose comparison settled the write at [param index]'s outcome, or [code]-1[/code] while the write is still pending judgement.

method.name: write_meter_after
method.description: The divergence meter measured at [method write_judged_transition] for the write at [param index], or [code]-1[/code] while it is still pending.

method.name: write_meter_before
method.description: The divergence meter measured just before the write at [param index] was recorded, the baseline [method write_meter_after] must beat for the write to count as a contraction.

method.name: write_null_operator
method.description: Whether the write at [param index] recorded a deliberate no-op rather than a corrective operator. A null operator's [method write_verify_run] is stretched to the maximum close run, since a no-op earns no shortened proof.

method.name: write_operator
method.description: The [enum NetwPredictJournal.Operator] the write at [param index] applied.

method.name: write_outcome
method.description: The outcome the write at [param index] has reached: [code]-1[/code] refused, [code]0[/code] pending, [code]1[/code] contracted, [code]2[/code] failed to contract, [code]3[/code] introduced a boundary, or [code]4[/code] withheld. Also [code]-1[/code] past [method write_count], indistinguishable there from a refused write, so bound [param index] against [method write_count] first.

method.name: write_target
method.description: The name of the entity or component the write at [param index] addressed, or an empty name when the operator named none.

method.name: write_trigger_shape
method.description: The trigger shape recorded for the write at [param index]: [code]0[/code] none of its evidence triggered, [code]1[/code] a mixed set triggered, or [code]2[/code] every field that triggered was withheld. Decides whether a later non-contraction on this write counts toward [method no_trigger_non_contractions], [method mixed_trigger_non_contractions], or [method withheld_non_contractions].

method.name: write_verdicts
method.description: How many comparisons have judged the write at [param index] without contracting it. The write's outcome settles once this reaches [method write_verify_run].

method.name: write_verify_run
method.description: How many non-contracting verdicts the write at [param index] tolerates before it is judged failed, derived from the ack age in effect when the write was recorded and stretched to the maximum for a [method write_null_operator] write.

constants.constant: The episode is actively judging comparisons against its writes.
The episode has closed, either by a sustained comparison agreement or by leaving fallback, and records no further writes.
The episode's owner has left speculation and is waiting on a quarantine proof before it may resume.
